Name: Plain Slime Hutch Interior
Author: sparrows413
Description:
[size=3][b]Version 1.2: Updated mod for Patch 1.6!
[/b][/size]Now features 2 versions: one with flooring that can be changed using a flooring item, and one with static flooring but with windows that cast light onto the floor.
This update also fixes a bug where setting Craftables to 'false' prevented the water bowls from being changed. Last but not least, the content.json is now updated to format 2.0 and should no longer throw errors in SMAPI's console! Thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/3526422]JennaJuffuffles[/url] for updating the code and allowing me to use it in this update :)

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -

I was looking around on the Nexus for a mod that changes the interior of the Slime Hutch to no longer be made of purple stone (since I use Elle's Buildings), but I couldn't find one. Every mod I found either made the interior space absolutely massive, made it unusable [i]as[/i] a Slime Hutch, or added all sorts of doodads and extras. That might be fine for other people, but it's not what I wanted.

So I busted out Tiled and made this!

The dimensions are identical to the regular Slime Hutch interior. However the walls are now made of grey stone and the floorboards have been slightly edited. I also removed the pipes above and below the water troughs. The windows on the wall work and will be dimmed at night or on rainy days.

There are two versions of the map:
[list]
[*][b]Version 1:[/b] allows the flooring of the hutch to be changed, but the windows on the back wall no longer cast light onto the floor. (They still change based on the time, though.)
[*][b]Version 2:[/b] the flooring is static and cannot be changed, but the windows on the back wall will cast light onto the floor when it is sunny outside.
[/list]
[b]Recoloured items:[/b]
The Slime Incubator and Egg-Press come in regular wood, dark wood (both with a metal cone on the Egg-Press, similar to the Auto-Grabber), and plain metal variants. The water bowls can be either kept as troughs, as in vanilla, or turned into little buckets, and both variants come in the same two woods and one metal as the craftables.

Additional Vibrant Pastoral-based recolours (mostly for the metal options) are located in the mod's assets folder; just use them to replace the options from the main mod if you want them.

Manifest.Name: Plain Slime Hutch
Manifest.Description: Makes the inside of the Slime Hutch look like a regular building. Optionally recolours the slime-related craftables and/or the water bowls to no longer be purple.
Manifest.Author: Sparrow
